newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Fondo Chiapas to float on Bolsa - paper.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Fondo Chiapas to float on Bolsa - paper.

text.p: Mexico's Fondo Chiapas, a fund promoting investment in the troubled southern state, plans to float 20-30 percent of its share capital on the Mexican Stock Exchange toward the end of 1997, daily newspaper Reforma said Tuesday.
The newspaper cited Gustavo Gonzalez Padilla, the fund's director general, as the source for its report.
Reforma also said Fondo Chiapas will receive a capital boost of $10 million in the first quarter of 1997 -- half coming from the International Finance Corp and half from six current fund partners.

Reforma named the partners as the Chiapas state government, state development bank Nacional Financiera, Grupo Financiero Bancrecer, Grupo Financiero Serfin, Grupo Empresarial El Porvenir, Grupo Mexicano de Desarrollo and sugar industrialists Grupo Escorpion.
